titulo: Info Matrix (Textos 04) — Cap. 4 — Elizabeth Bathory e Matou Shinji

linhas.en:
In the west, dragons are regarded as "devils,"
but in China, Dragons are godlike existences.
If #RUBS   Western#RUBEdragons#REND are the strongest of the Phantasmal Species,
then #RUBS   Eastern#RUBEDragons#REND are invincible; beings with no need to fight.

But even Dragons have a weakness.
When the scale beneath their jaw is touched, it will
become enraged and devastate the earth with their power.

In this way, even such perfect existences have flaws.
Elizabeth is no exception, and this scale is on
a part of her body (near her tailbone).
If seen, she'll go flush-red with embarrassment,
and when she's done panicking,
she will approach the person with two choices:
"Will you be killed by me?" or "Will you marry me?"
キーワード１偽名テキスト

Due to her skill "Innocent Monster,"
Elizabeth has been demonized as a dragon of mixed blood.

A dragon's strongest weapon is the use
of their attribute's Dragon's Breath.
Red dragons, fire; blue dragons, electricity;
black dragons, acid.
Their breath has a wide range of effects.

……according to a certain rulebook,
the breath's damage is the same as their strength stat.
Considering it's damage that far surpasses humans
spread evenly across an entire army, it's not unreasonable
for a single dragon to destroy an entire country.

Elizabeth's Dragon's Breath is made of ultrasonic waves.
Since she's been demonized, her lungs have shifted
spiritually and gained terrifying lung capacity.
Amplified by her Noble Phantasm, Elizabeth's voice
could be called noise that could reverberate through
and destroy part of the Tokyo Dome.

It was this moment that she became Saber's rival,
both in name and reality.
キーワード２偽名テキスト

A Noble Phantasm that summons the castle Elizabeth
presided over in life, turning into a stage just for her.
The worst, most disgusting Noble Phantasm that Elizabeth,
who began dreaming of becoming the ultimate idol,
came to possess upon becoming a Servant.

The castle's name is the prison castle, Čachtice.
The demonic castle where hundreds of girls
were tortured to death, where Elizabeth soaked in
a blood bath made from those girls' lifeblood
to maintain a great amount of mana and charm.

With singing talent that only…… 1, 2 people on the planet
could match and this castle remodeled as a stage
with gigantic amplifiers, it truly is a hell on Earth.

A collaboration with the Golden Theater cannot be allowed.
宝具・偽名のテキストを記述します。

A skill that induces madness and raises their stats.

……but as Elizabeth still has her reasoning,
the benefits from it are very low.
Rather than increasing her strength or endurance,
she's simply in a state where she "doesn't feel pain."
スキル１偽名テキスト

Being mentally ill.
It is not the Mad Enhancement usual to Berserkers.
Unable to feel the pain of others or read the atmosphere.
The ability of mental super armor.
スキル２偽名テキスト

A hidden skill that even she herself is unaware of.

You'd think it was fabricated by "Innocent Monster,"
but the truth is she really does have the blood of dragons.

She's endowed with Magic Resistance of the same rank
as the Saber from Fate/stay night.

Its source is the Báthory family's coat of arms.
It was a shield-shaped crest with a red fang,
symbolizing a dragon's courage, strength,
and cruelty in never leaving an enemy alive.
スキル３偽名テキスト

Migraine:
Though in life she was one of the most infamous,
abnormal killers in the world, when you compare her
with the cruel tastes of people like her,
her characteristic is that her tendencies varies.

For the majority of serial killers, they boil down to:
those who enjoy killing, murder;
those who enjoy pain, suffering;
those who eat people, cannibalism;
they make up a trend to their brutal hobbies.
But she wasn't consistent.
Disturbingly, she purportedly enjoyed all of the above.

But on the other hand, she is lacking the abnormal behavior
that serial killers in recent years have displayed,
such as rape murders, collecting body parts,
using people as ingredients in food, etc.

According to one theory, she suffered terrible migraines,
only to subside when she was abusing others.

Of course, this claim's authenticity cannot be confirmed.

Though Elizabeth is only known for her abnormalities,
she also left behind good deeds. At the age of 15,
she married her husband Ferenc II and, in his stead,
protected their dominion when he was away during the war.

The two got along extremely well as husband and wife,
and records indicate that Elizabeth invested funds
into both students studying abroad and returning students,
as well as promoting arts and sciences within the country.

             ◆

There were rumors that she was interested in black magic,
but apparently this was actually the use of medicinal herbs
to make something akin to what is now known as a face mask.

Even the episode where she killed more than 600 women
and the trial in absentia are theorized to be mostly false,
derived from folklore and the Hungarian Habsburgs' plan
to expel her from their circles.

However, it can't be said that they were all false charges.
Even if the torture devices and cruel dramas were folklore,
from the circumstantial evidence alone, it's clear that
she enjoyed killing people.
設定１偽名テキスト

Character Background II:
To Elizabeth, killing the common people in droves
was her "ordinary" everyday life.
If anything could be considered her misfortune,
it is that she had no one to challenge her abnormality,
to teach her that her deeds were atrocities.

Several years after she started taking blood.
Elizabeth's brutal acts extended to even the daughters
of the aristocracy, and she finally received the indictment
that her character so deserved.

The year was 1611.
At the trial conducted in her absence, she was convicted
and imprisoned in one of the rooms of Čachtice Castle.

And just like that,
she who was already feared as a devil,
was thoroughly sealed away by the people.

#ROFS-004#RUBSThe people#RUBEThey#REND whispered.
To see her figure was frightening.
To hear her voice was frightening.
Memories of losing their daughters, memories of themselves
giving them to her, remembering them was frightening―――

Fathers who gave their daughters. Elizabeth's relatives.
Her compatriots in aristocratic society, as if to
hide their own guilt, concealed her in a prison of stone.

The room that Elizabeth used in her final days……
a prison in her castle's basement with nothing but
a small gap to feed her. And in that room without
exits or windows, all sealed from the outside,
she continued to ask, "Why?" until her final moments.

Such as "Why? Why?"
or "I didn't do anything wrong."

It is said that her voice echoed through her stone prison,
so much that it irritated the soldiers
so they plugged the opening to silence it.

After that, there was no one who witnessed her alive.
On August 21, 1614, the soldiers noticed
the smell of rotting flesh, confirming her death.

From then on, she became a legend as the Blood Countess.
